_comment: Alexa+ add-on manifest. Schema verified against the Alexa+ MCP Toolkit quickstart (2026-09-14). Deploy with: alexa-ai deploy
_endpointNote: integrations[0].config.endpoints.default.uri is the ONLY field still requiring a decision. It must point at the deployed WickMcp stack — either the raw API Gateway/CloudFront URL from the CDK output, or a CNAME you control. Set it before running alexa-ai deploy.
_assetsNote: Legal pages and media are served from GitHub Pages (repo Settings > Pages > main, /docs). Image files must exist at these exact URLs and at these exact pixel sizes before deploy will accept the manifest.

en-US.shortDescription: Ask how someone living alone has been this week, in plain language.
en-US.fullDescription: Wick turns the television into the care surface for the person being cared for. It watches the front door through Ring, reads the day through a Bee wearable, and learns the household's ordinary rhythm — so it can tell a distant family member the truth about the week, without ever turning a living room into a surveillance feed. Nothing about health, money or relationships leaves the house without permission, and the resident sees their own week before anyone else can read it.
examplePhrases: how has my mum been this week
